overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the February 27, 2013 notice topic on the ModSpace lease was sufficiently specific, though the Board was encouraged to add detail, which it did in later notices.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board's February 27, 2013 meeting notice topic on a ModSpace modular unit lease was not sufficiently specific.
allegations.key_passage: The topic, "Consider and sign contract with ModSpace for the lease of modular unit," was sufficiently specific to describe the topic to be discussed, though it is clear that additional detail concerning the temporary re-location of Human Services may have been helpful to the public.
